**AI Guard:** Support disabling automatic evaluation per integration [#11326](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11326) - **AppSec:** Analyze global fetch requests with SSRF RASP [#11191](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11191) - **AppSec:** Block RASP matches on Next.js requests [#11258](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11258) - **AppSec:** Extract nextjs response schema [#11227](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11227) - **vite:** Intercept the exports of instrumented ES modules [#11032](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11032) ### Fixes - **AppSec:** Block Next.js Pages Router requests on body attacks [#11257](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11257) - **AppSec:** Block Next.js requests on query and App Router body attacks [#11133](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11133) - **bundler:** Resolve dc-polyfill import from the bundler module ID [#11245](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11245) - **datastreams:** Hash pathways with FNV-1 64 like dd-trace-java [#11226](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11226) - **Debugger:** Keep snapshots within the global rate limit over time [#11280](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11280) - **General:** Lint and GraphQL checks for dependency updates [#11205](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11205) - **LLM Observability:** Do not fail streamed requests on bad patching [#11282](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11282) - **mongodb:** Preserve tracing when heartbeat spans are disabled [#11223](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11223) - **OpenTelemetry:** Make OTEL_SDK_DISABLED disable all signals [#11263](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11263) - **supabase:** Compile queryStringObfuscation before building url [#11328](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11328) - **Test Optimization:** Finalize each spec once when Cypress runs every after:spec handler [#11259](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11259) - **Test Optimization:** Lowercase commit SHAs and report GitLab MR head SHA [#11314](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11314) - **Test Optimization:** Register Vitest browser hooks for every spec [#11255](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11255) - **Test Optimization:** Report AppVeyor merge SHA and Azure PR head SHA [#11312](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11312) - **Test Optimization:** Report malformed commit SHAs as provided [#11318](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11318) - **Test Optimization:** Support 5.1.1 [#11324](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11324) - **ws:** Apply OTel HTTP semantics to upgrade spans [#10882](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10882) ### Performance - **Profiling:** Yield between collection and encoder starts [#11325](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11325) - **Serverless:** Preload MicroVM process discovery [#11231](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/11231) -
